name: opencode-quests
description: Durable Quests, native worker dispatch, completion delivery and Quest Web APIs
about: Turns a stated goal into a stored Quest: title, steps, a chosen project, a worker run, completion delivery and verification evidence. It adds the Quest tools and Quest Web API, the giver session, worker admission and checkouts, and keeps the record on disk so a later session can resume it.
needs: one git checkout per project it works in
the models plugin for routed worker runs
